output.explanation: Follows the pseudocode step by step: empty check, root-file check, group by first segment, find direct-child CONTROL_<n>.txt via fullmatch, fail on 0 or >1, compare n with (folder file count - 1), no file changes. I hand-traced all 8 test cases and the 3 examples. Valid cases return without changes. The failing cases call pkg.fail. In zero_count_control, D002 has a control CONTROL_1 plus the nested CONTROL_5, which counts as one other file, so it passes.
